title: Las Vegas Strip
html:
Las Vegas Strip is a North American map added to OpenFront in Update 33.0 by crunchybbb — Skinny long map with roads as water and casinos as nations.

Nations

The map features 34 named nations, including Sphere, Las Vegas Premium Outlets, World Market Center, Fremont Street, Las Vegas Downtown and Arts District.
